headline: No API change breaks the bot today; the ideas check whether a mover's order book can take your full position, show who is behind a 15-minute move, and make the scanner wait 20 seconds while a cooldown is on.

ideas.title: "Too thin for your size" check on the top picks
ideas.why: At 20–40× your position is large for a small coin. For the 5 morning picks, read the order book and work out how far price would slip if you filled your usual size. If that slippage eats a big share of a normal scalp, the card says so before you enter.

ideas.title: Who is moving it: 15-minute OI + taker label
ideas.why: The scanner reads OI and taker flow on 1h, but you trade the 15m. Label each card "new longs", "shorts closing", "new shorts" or "longs closing" from the last 15m, so you can tell a move with fresh money behind it from a squeeze that may already be done.

ideas.title: 20-second pause on the scanner during a cooldown
ideas.why: After a loss, opening the scanner to find the next trade is the first step of a revenge run. While the tilt guard's cooldown is on, the scanner first shows today's P&L and your next allowed entry time for 20 seconds, then shows the coins.
